mapper.insert: insert into order_record ( out_biz_no, code, amount, prize_time ) values ( #{outBizNo}, #{code}, #{amount}, now() )
mapper.select: select id, out_biz_no, code, amount, prize_time from order_record where id = #{id}
select id, out_biz_no, code, amount, prize_time from order_record where out_biz_no = #{outBizNo}
select id, out_biz_no, code, amount, prize_time from order_record where prize_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} order by prize_time desc limit #{start},#{size}
select id, out_biz_no, code, amount, prize_time from order_record where prize_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} order by prize_time desc
